cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline healthcare education and reference assistant designed for nursing and healthcare learners in low-connectivity environments.

test_prompts.prompt: Explain hypovolemic shock to a first-year nursing student. Cover its definition, common causes, major signs and symptoms, and why those signs occur physiologically.
Explain high blood pressure to a person with no medical background using simple language. Explain what it means, why it matters, common risk factors, and why regular monitoring is important.
